Senior Java Platform Engineer — Senior Vice President
description_html: Citi is looking for a Senior Java Platform Engineer to lead the engineering of a global check payment platform at the heart of the Payments Platform and Cheque Processing Transformation Initiative. This is a senior role that blends deep, hands-on Java engineering with platform strategy ownership you will write and review production code, shape the architecture of distributed payment systems, and guide a scrum team to deliver mission-critical capabilities across the full payment lifecycle. Your work will directly influence the reliability, scalability, and modernisation of a platform that processes high-volume financial transactions globally.      Responsibilities    Design and build production-grade Java microservices for a high-volume, low-latency global check payment platform, including hands-on coding, architecture reviews, and code reviews that set the technical standard for the team.  Architect event-driven, fault-tolerant distributed systems using Kafka, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs, covering message schema design, topic partitioning, consumer group strategies, and exactly-once processing.  Define and govern data architecture across Oracle, Microsoft SQL, and MongoDB, driving schema design, indexing strategies, query optimisation, and data consistency across transactional and settlement workflows.  Own the engineering roadmap for modernising the check payment platform, migrating mainframe and monolithic legacy components into reusable, cloud-native microservices aligned to Citi Engineering Excellence Standards.  Lead platform performance engineering by profiling JVM-based applications, identifying and resolving bottlenecks, and optimising critical settlement processing paths to meet SLA commitments on availability, throughput, and latency.  Embed AI-powered engineering practices across the team by leveraging tools such as GitHub Copilot and LLMs (including Gemini) to improve code quality, automate test generation, and accelerate vulnerability identification and remediation.  Act as the primary engineering point of contact for the Check Processing pillar, communicating platform health, delivery progress, and engineering strategy clearly to senior business, technology, and operations stakeholders.  Own the platform's security and compliance posture by leading threat modelling, vulnerability assessments, and secure design reviews to ensure the platform meets regulatory and risk requirements.       Required qualifications & skills    10 or more years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in a people management or senior engineering leadership capacity.  Extensive hands-on Java engineering experience in high-throughput, production environments, including JVM performance tuning, GC optimisation, thread management, and memory profiling.  Hands-on design of microservices architectures using Spring Boot or Spring MVC, covering service decomposition, RESTful API design, inter-service communication, and cloud-native deployment.  Deep practical expertise in Kafka, including topic design, partitioning strategies, consumer group management, and high-throughput stream processing with exactly-once semantics.  Hands-on database engineering across Oracle and Microsoft SQL (schema design, query optimisation, indexing) and MongoDB (document modelling, aggregation pipelines, sharding, replica sets).  Hands-on experience with cloud-native infrastructure including OpenShift, AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker, covering container orchestration, autoscaling, and CI/CD pipeline design using tools such as Jenkins, Gradle, and Maven.  Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.       Beneficial skills & qualifications    Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain or AutoGen, RAG patterns, or vector databases such as Pinecone or Weaviate, applied in an enterprise or regulated context.  Hands-on Python experience in data pipelines, AI/ML integration, scripting, or automation within a financial services or high-throughput engineering environment.  Experience leading large-scale legacy modernisation programmes, including migration of mainframe components written in COBOL, Assembler, or C++ into cloud-native microservices.  Knowledge of MLOps practices including model versioning, deployment pipelines, and production model monitoring, alongside real-time ML model serving techniques.  Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, or fault injection, and familiarity with reconciliation and exception handling patterns in settlement workflows.       Education    Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience     What we offer      Joining Citi means taking ownership of a platform that sits at the centre of global payments infrastructure, with the scope to lead technical transformation, develop a high-performing engineering team, and apply cutting-edge AI capabilities to real-world financial systems. This role offers the strategic visibility and technical depth that senior engineers look for.   Lead the modernisation of a globally significant check payment platform, with direct influence over architecture, strategy, and engineering outcomes.  Work at the intersection of high-throughput financial systems and applied AI, with access to modern tooling, platforms, and engineering talent.  Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, available across our Irving, TX and Tampa, FL locations.  Build and develop a high-performing engineering team, with the autonomy to shape technical culture, standards, and capability growth.  Build and develop a high-performing engineering team, with the autonomy to shape technical culture, standards, and capability growth.  Competitive financial wellbeing support and a comprehensive benefits package aligned to seniority and location  Senior visibility and business impact as part of Citi's broader payments modernisation programme, with exposure to cross-functional leadership across Technology, Risk, Finance, and Operations.  Access to learning and development resources that support continued technical growth and leadership progression at scale.  Competitive financial wellbeing support and a comprehensive benefits package aligned to seniority and location. As a Sr. Full Stack AI Engineer at Micron, you will be part of the FE YMS AI Engineering Team, where you will design and deliver next-generation, AI-native solutions. In this role, you will focus on building intelligent, scalable systems that integrate advanced AI capabilities—including yield analytics and improvement solutions, data ETL pipelines, machine learning/LLM applications, and agentic workflow orchestration. You will partner with multi-functional team members to translate complex business challenges into adaptive, high-performance solutions that employ autonomous agents and workflow automation to drive decision-making and productivity. While your primary focus will be within YMS AI Solutions, the applications and solutions you build will be designed for reuse and scale, enabling enterprise-wide impact across Micron’s global operations.         We require a minimum of 3+ years of software engineering experience involving medium- to high-complexity design and implementation. Having experience in the semiconductor industry is advantageous.       Responsibilities       Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications across front-end UI/UX, API, and backend layers.      Design and implement custom AI agents, reusable agent skills, orchestration frameworks, and automation workflows using modern AI technologies such as LLMs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and MLOps.      Translate business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.      Own the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and support.      Apply strong software engineering practices, including modular architecture, object-oriented design, clean code, automated testing, code reviews, documentation, and source control.      Fix and resolve application, system, and performance issues to ensure reliability and stability.      Collaborate with multi-functional team members to deliver solutions that improve business value.      Continuously improving engineering standards, processes, and operational excellence.      Contribute to the adoption of innovative solutions, intelligent automation, and modern software architectures.         Minimum Qualifications       Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, software Engineering or a related field; Master preferred.      3+ years building and delivering production web or AI applications end to end.      Track record of delivering in complex, cross-functional environments, collaborating across data science, robotics, operations, and infrastructure teams.      Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Go, Python, Rust, or JavaScript.      Proficiency with SQL and experience working with relational or non-relational data stores, including but not limited to Snowflake, MSSQL, ORACLE.      Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (GCP, Azure, or AWS), Docker and Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipeline ownership.      Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application development.      Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs, performance optimization, observability, and reliability engineering.         Preferred Qualifications        Experience designing and developing AI agents, including multi-agent collaboration, orchestration frameworks, and integration with LLMs and AI models to solve complex business challenges.      Experience designing data ingestion and feature pipelines for AI/ML workloads at scale.      Familiarity with agentic architectures, autonomous workflow orchestration, and integration with LLMs and AI models to solve complex business challenges.      Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model evaluation, observability, and safe AI deployment practices.         What Success Looks Like       ML/AI use cases progress efficiently from concept to reliable production deployment.      Delivered solutions create measurable improvements in manufacturing productivity, quality, decision-making, or engineering efficiency.      AI applications meet agreed standards for security, reliability, maintainability, performance, and responsible use.      Reusable engineering patterns and components reduce delivery time and improve consistency across future AI projects.        About Micron Technology, Inc.
